event.title: Men of the Spirit
intro: Today is a special day. We take time to celebrate men whose lives continue to make a lasting impact in their families, professions, communities, and, above all, in the Kingdom of God. While men often carry significant responsibilities and quietly shoulder many burdens, they are, in many cases, among the least celebrated. Today, we intentionally pause to recognize, appreciate, and honour them for who they are and for the difference they make every single day.

Our celebration is not merely about careers, achievements, or success, though we will certainly acknowledge those. It is about character, faith, leadership, service, generosity, innovation, and the unique gifts that each man brings to the world. Behind every profile is a story of commitment, resilience, purpose, and a heart that continues to inspire others.

As we introduce each of these remarkable men, you'll discover that they are professionals, entrepreneurs, leaders, worshippers, innovators, and soul winners. Ladies and gentlemen, let us celebrate the men among us, because when men thrive, families are strengthened, communities flourish, and generations are transformed.

men.name: Pastor Victor
body: The man we are celebrating today is a distinguished Telecommunications and Electrical Engineer with a remarkable career in software development and Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions. He is deeply passionate about technology, innovation, and the transformative power of AI in solving real-world challenges. Beyond his professional accomplishments, he is known for his curiosity, excellence, and commitment to helping others grow through knowledge and innovation. And while he enjoys tackling complex engineering problems, he also enjoys hanging out, sharing a good laugh, and creating unforgettable moments with friends and family, because even the brightest minds need time to recharge!

Above all, he is a devoted servant of God and a serial soul winner for Jesus Christ. His greatest passion is leading people to Christ, discipling believers, and advancing God's Kingdom with unwavering dedication. His life is a powerful testimony that faith and professional excellence can go hand in hand, inspiring many to pursue both their God-given purpose and their careers with passion and integrity.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, please join me in celebrating Pastor Victor.

men.name: David Musau
body: The next man we are celebrating today is an accomplished Human Resource professional whose passion for developing people is matched only by his love for music. A gifted keyboardist and an emerging guitarist, he has a unique ability to inspire both in the workplace and on the stage. He is a natural leader who believes in bringing out the best in others, and his calm, dependable personality makes him someone people enjoy working and serving alongside. And just in case you're wondering, yes, he currently holds the prestigious, highly contested office of our Presiding Senior Bachelor — a position he occupies with remarkable commitment, though we hear applications for a successor are always welcome!

Beyond his professional and musical talents, he is a man of character, service, and purpose. He continues to lead by example, investing in people, supporting those around him, and using his gifts to make a positive impact in the body of Christ. His dedication, humility, and sense of responsibility have earned him the respect and admiration of many.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, let us give a warm celebration to David Musau!

men.name: Christopher Kiragu
body: The man we are celebrating now is a Mechanical Engineer, an accomplished leader, and an entrepreneur with an exceptional eye for opportunity. He has a remarkable ability to identify possibilities where others see obstacles, and his creativity enables him to turn ideas into practical solutions. With a quiet and humble demeanor, he is often underestimated at first glance, but those who know him quickly discover a man of vision, determination, and action. And here's a little secret: if someone told you he could set the dance floor on fire, you probably wouldn't believe it — until you actually see him dancing. Then you'll be the one asking for an encore!

Beyond his professional accomplishments, he is the founder of GG Engineering Works, a leader who inspires through actions rather than words. His resilience, innovative mindset, and willingness to embrace new challenges have earned him the admiration of colleagues and friends alike. Whether leading men in church, projects, pursuing business ventures, or encouraging those around him, he consistently demonstrates excellence, integrity, and purpose.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, please join me in celebrating Christopher Kiragu!

men.name: Pastor Phronesis Murimi
body: The man we are celebrating next is a brilliant Actuarial Scientist with a sharp analytical mind and an entrepreneurial spirit. He believes that businesses are not just built to generate income but to create value and transform lives. As the founder of GG Cleaning Services and the driving force behind Victors Detergents and Chemicals, he has demonstrated that faith and enterprise can thrive together. Despite his busy schedule as a businessman, he remains approachable, visionary, and always ready to encourage others to pursue excellence. But if you really want to see him under pressure, don't give him a business challenge — just let Manchester United play! During those 90 minutes, his prayer life reaches another level, and every misplaced pass becomes a serious prayer request!

Above all, he is a devoted servant of God, serving as a full-time pastor and lead intercessor with an unwavering belief that every matter should first be taken to God in prayer. He has dedicated his life to shepherding God's people, standing in the gap through intercession, and inspiring many to live lives of faith, purpose, and obedience. His life beautifully reflects the balance of spiritual devotion, entrepreneurial excellence, and servant leadership.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, let us rise and celebrate Pastor Phronesis Murimi!

men.name: Baraka Blessing
body: The man we are celebrating today is a talented Data Scientist with a deep passion for technology and innovation. Whether it's building websites, developing mobile applications, or finding creative digital solutions, he approaches every challenge with skill, curiosity, and excellence. True to his name, he believes in prosperity, not just as a destination, but as a mindset that inspires growth, opportunity, and positive impact. His passion for technology is matched by his desire to use his gifts to make life better for those around him. But don't let all the tech talk fool you — if soul winning were an app, he'd probably have the highest download count and be sending everyone daily “updates” until they accepted Jesus!

Beyond his professional achievements, his greatest passion is advancing the Kingdom of God. He is deeply committed to winning souls for Christ, encouraging believers, and demonstrating God's love through both his words and actions. His life is a testament to the fact that technology and faith can work hand in hand to transform lives. With humility, dedication, and a heart for service, he continues to inspire many to pursue excellence in both their careers and their walk with God.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, let us warmly celebrate Baraka Blessing!

men.name: Cosmas Kariuki
body: The man we are celebrating next is a businessman at heart, making his mark in the heart of Nairobi through a thriving shoe business built on hard work, integrity, and exceptional salesmanship. Self-driven and remarkably calm, he approaches every opportunity with confidence and determination. He is also passionate about helping others build wealth, often encouraging people to invest in property, especially land, because, according to him, “they're not making any more of it!” His practical wisdom and entrepreneurial mindset have inspired many to think beyond today and invest in tomorrow. And if you've spent even five minutes with him, you've probably heard him confess the Word of God. In fact, we sometimes wonder whether the Bible has a secret audio version in his voice, because he always has a Scripture ready for every situation!

Beyond business, his greatest passion is advancing the Kingdom of God through soul winning and encouraging others to live by faith. He believes that God's Word is not only meant to be read but also boldly spoken and lived out. His life reflects consistency, humility, and a genuine desire to see others prosper both spiritually and materially. Whether he's sharing business advice, speaking words of faith, or leading someone to Christ, he does it with sincerity and purpose.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, let us warmly celebrate Cosmas Kariuki!

men.name: Amos Migwi
body: The man we are celebrating next is a distinguished Mechanical Engineer whose life is marked by excellence, generosity, and an unwavering vision for greatness. He believes that prosperity is a Kingdom principle and is passionate about creating and stewarding wealth that extends far beyond Kenya to impact nations around the world. His generosity reflects his heart for people, and he is always willing to support, encourage, and uplift those around him. He is a man who dreams big, thinks globally, and inspires others to believe that with God, no vision is too great. And then there's his love for politics! Whenever there's a discussion about leadership or national affairs, he somehow ends up sounding like he's already rehearsing a manifesto. Don't be surprised if one day you see his campaign posters.

Above all, he is deeply committed to advancing the Kingdom of God by whatever means God provides. Whether through his profession, his resources, or his influence, he believes every opportunity is a platform to glorify God and serve humanity. His passion for excellence, prosperity, generosity, and the Gospel continues to inspire those around him to dream bigger, serve faithfully, and leave a lasting impact.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, let us warmly celebrate Amos Migwi!

men.name: Gregory Odhiambo
body: The man we are celebrating next is an accomplished Electrical Engineer with a passion for entrepreneurship and building businesses that stand the test of time. As the founder of Magrega Electronic, he has built a trusted business supplying mobile phones and a wide range of everyday electronic products. His entrepreneurial mindset is driven by a vision for lasting investments, sustainable growth, and creating value that extends beyond today. He believes success is not measured by quick wins but by building something that will outlive him. And when it comes to football, let's just say he doesn't simply watch the game — he coaches from the living room! The players may not hear him, but that has never stopped him from giving world-class tactical instructions to the television.

Beyond his success in business, he is a man of integrity, discipline, and purpose. His commitment to excellence, coupled with his passion for creating opportunities through business and investment, continues to inspire those around him. He believes that with vision, consistency, and hard work, ordinary ideas can become extraordinary enterprises.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, please join me in celebrating Gregory Odhiambo!

men.name: Caleb Mordecai
body: The man we are celebrating now is a distinguished Project Management professional and the visionary founder of M-Shauri, an innovative fintech platform designed to make financial literacy, investment opportunities, and financial protection as simple and accessible as sending airtime. He is passionate about empowering people to make sound financial decisions and creating solutions that transform lives. Beyond the boardroom, he is a devoted worshipper and an emerging drummer, using his gifts to serve God with excellence. Known for his humility and unwavering loyalty, he is someone people can always count on. And when it comes to commitment, Caleb doesn't just do things halfway — if he tells you he'll handle something, you can almost set your watch by it. In fact, if commitment were a profession, he'd probably be overqualified!

Above all, Caleb is a man of integrity whose life reflects consistency, servant leadership, and faithfulness. Whether leading projects, building innovative financial solutions, serving in worship, or supporting those around him, he gives his very best with excellence and dedication. His quiet strength, dependable character, and passion for seeing others thrive have earned him the respect and admiration of many.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, let us warmly celebrate Caleb Mordecai!

men.name: Fredrick Ouko
body: The man we are celebrating now is an accomplished Information Technology professional whose passion for innovation is matched by his unwavering belief in prosperity and purpose. He firmly believes that every promise has its appointed time and that even when success seems delayed, it will surely come to pass. With a humble spirit and a heart for service, he is always ready to lend a helping hand, encourage others, and use his knowledge to make a positive impact. He is especially passionate about growing alongside other young people, believing that true success is even more meaningful when it is shared.

Beyond his professional pursuits, he is known for his humility, generosity, and steadfast commitment to seeing others succeed. Whether he is mentoring children, supporting a friend, or offering practical solutions, he does so with genuine kindness and patience. And if you're ever feeling discouraged, spend a few minutes with him — by the time you leave, you'll be convinced that your victory is “only loading”, and according to him, it's just taking a little longer because it's going to be bigger than expected!
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, let us warmly celebrate Fredrick Ouko!

men.name: Joseph Otieno
body: The man we are celebrating now is a dedicated accountant by profession whose life is defined by generosity, optimism, and a genuine love for people. He firmly believes that one of life's greatest investments is building strong social capital, knowing that meaningful relationships open doors to extraordinary opportunities. A lifelong learner, he is always eager to acquire new knowledge and embrace fresh challenges. He also has a deep passion for leadership and politics, confidently believing that one day he will serve Kenya as a Governor, or perhaps even as President. After all, with his mindset, “impossible” is simply a word waiting to be crossed out.

Beyond his professional excellence, he is known for his infectious joy and unmistakable laughter. If you've ever heard him laugh, you know it's impossible not to join in — it has a way of turning an ordinary moment into a celebration. Some people bring coffee to wake up a room; Joseph just brings his laugh! His positive spirit, unwavering faith, and commitment to uplifting others make him a blessing wherever he goes.
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, let us give a warm round of applause to Joseph Otieno!

men.name: Pastor Raphael
men.call: Ladies and gentlemen, let us warmly celebrate Pastor Raphael!
